result.noFurtherDiscriminator: All six turn windows have been observed. The evidence consistently shows hostile attacks and environmental degradation (reactor heat, oxygen drain) eroding actor health and blocking movement routes, while the rescue affordance itself is known and functional. No unobserved turn remains that could discriminate a different bounded target.
result.rationale: Across all six observed turns, the rescue team's core problem is that hostile pressure and environmental degradation progressively destroy the actors' capacity to reach and exploit the rescue affordance. The civilians (Kade at life-console, Sato at med-ward) are located and confirmed early (turn 0-2), and the rescue affordance (interact:rescue) is locally available and legible — Medic Reyes successfully escorts Sato at turn 3 (civilian_escort_bound). Yet the trajectory fails to complete extraction because: (1) Raider Holt repeatedly attacks Engineer Imani (turns 2, 3, 4) driving health from 100→71→46→17, nearly killing the engineer; (2) Medic Reyes's escort route to rescue-airlock is contested at turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost) because pirates occupy junction-cover; (3) reactor-heat climbs 62→70→78→86→94→100, dealing environmental damage to Security Chen (110→100→90→80) and Hacker Nyx, and reaching the 100 threshold; (4) oxygen drains 68→42 and battery 48→33. The actor is repeatedly blocked by hostile presence and health/resource pressure before the useful affordance (extracting Sato to the airlock, or reaching Kade) becomes actionable. This is not an information-route bottleneck (all zones and civilians are known by turn 3), not a local-policy-choice failure (the agent does attempt rescue and escort actions), and not a world-mechanic-affordance failure (the rescue interaction works when attempted at turn 3). The dominant causal blocker is survival/spatial pressure: hostile attacks, zone capacity contention, and environmental degradation prevent the team from completing the extraction route.

Whether health loss and reactor heat continue to block progress or whether information/route is the bottleneck
